manufacturer.name: BQ TimberLock
manufacturer.description: BQ TimberLock Pergola Systems designs and manufactures premium flat-pack architectural pergola frames for residential and light commercial outdoor living applications. The TimberLock range is available in Accoya acetylated timber and Australian hardwood glulam — all systems arrive pre-drilled with proprietary stainless steel fixings included.

cards.name: BQ TimberLock Accoya Pergola
cards.subcategory: Flat-pack Accoya timber architectural pergola frame
cards.description: BQ TimberLock Accoya is a premium flat-pack architectural pergola frame system manufactured from Accoya acetylated radiata pine. Accoya offers Class 1 above-ground durability, exceptional dimensional stability and outstanding paint/oil retention - making it ideal for exposed coastal and high-rainfall environments. Each kit arrives pre-drilled with all members labelled for assembly. Proprietary stainless steel fixings, post bases and rafter saddles are included. Available in 3m, 4m and 6m bay widths at 3m rafter span.

cards.name: BQ TimberLock Glulam Hardwood Pergola
cards.subcategory: Flat-pack Australian hardwood glulam pergola frame
cards.description: BQ TimberLock Glulam is a flat-pack architectural pergola frame system manufactured from Australian hardwood glulam - H3 treated, finger-jointed and laminated for strength and stability. Sourced from certified Australian plantation and native hardwood mills. Each kit arrives pre-drilled with all members labelled. Proprietary stainless steel fixings, post bases and rafter saddles are included. Available in 3m, 4m and 6m bay widths at 3m rafter span.
